## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to an issue when appropriate.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior and pass locally.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when appropriate.
- [ ] No credentials, account IDs, private ARNs, personal paths, or customer data are included.
- [ ] The compiled AWS operation registry and read-only boundary are unchanged, or the change is explicitly justified and tested.
- [ ] `./scripts/security-check.sh` passes.
